Subject: Post-call recap + next steps (Aurora Tech)

Hi Ethan —

Thanks again for taking the call earlier. Quick recap from our side and the proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Call summary:
- Primary use case: in-product assistance for customer support to reduce average handle time and auto-draft responses for Tier 1 agents.
- Expected Q3 pilot across 3 support teams (~20 agents).
- Key success metrics: 20% reduction in AHT, CSAT neutral or +5, integration with Zendesk and secure logging.

Open items / asks for next steps:
1) Economic buyer / budget owner — who owns the budget for piloting AI infra and production inference?
2) Procurement / legal info — any standard SOW or procurement cadence we should follow?
3) Intro call — propose a 30-min intro with the economic buyer + procurement to align on requirements and timeline.

Attached is a one-pager and a draft mutual action plan (MAP) to give your team a sense of milestones and typical timelines.

If you can share the right contact (or loop them into this thread), I’ll send a short agenda and calendar invites.

My availability next week: Tue/Wed 10–12 PT, Thu 2–4 PT.

Thanks,

— Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf, Redwood_RFI_Answers.docx

Thanks Marissa — great recap.

Quick answers:
- Economic buyer is my VP of Product, Samantha Young (cc’d in my planned intro). She signs off on pilot budgets for platform integrations.
- Procurement handles contracting but they prefer a short SOW + standard T&Cs; I’ll loop procurement@auroratech.com.

I’ll introduce Samantha and procurement on Monday. From my side we’re aiming to kick off a pilot in July, so aligning on the MAP and data/security asks sooner is helpful.

Thanks Ethan for offering to introduce. Samantha — quick intro: I’m Marissa on the enterprise team at Redwood. We help engineering teams run production-grade inference with predictable latency and clear unit economics (batching, KV cache, quantization profiles, etc.).

Proposed 30-min agenda for an intro call:
- 5 min: intros + outcomes you want from a pilot
- 10 min: technical approach & required integrations (Zendesk, data flow, logging)
- 10 min: security/compliance and procurement checklist (SOC2, data retention, audit logs)
- 5 min: timeline & next steps / MAP alignment

Attachments: I attached our Mutual Action Plan and an RFI answers doc that should help procurement with initial questions.

Proposed times next week (all PT): Tue 10:30, Wed 11:00, Thu 2:30. Happy to adjust.

If you prefer, I can send a shorter deck focused on expected unit economics for the pilot.

Looking forward to coordinating — I’ll stay on the thread for procurement questions and to keep the MAP updated.

Best,
